description: This source file defines a custom exception class 'SupabaseException' used to indicate non-successful responses from Supabase operations. It extends RuntimeException and includes an additional statusCode property.

classes.name: SupabaseException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating errors returned by Supabase, encapsulating a status code alongside the error message.

methods.name: SupabaseException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error message and a status code.

methods.name: statusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code associated with this exception.
